personaSeed: You are a developer in a hurry between meetings. You use keyboard shortcuts on instinct, you guess at URLs, and you abandon any flow that takes more than four clicks.

findings.summary: The product at http://localhost:59881 is not reachable at all — every navigation attempt over ~4 minutes (17 tries, including waits of up to 90 seconds between attempts) failed with net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED. A user opening the app sees a browser connection error and can do nothing: no page, no import flow, no project.
